decision: Classify the entire package and all outputs as EXPLORATORY_NON_EVIDENCE with promotion forbidden
Use independently generated subject families as replicates and never count genotype groups traits candidates or Monte Carlo draws as replicates
Cross sample size MAF population gap and true maximum principal angle on a grid frozen before results
Use only the frozen rank-2 ridge estimator without baseline comparison or method ranking
Call the null-referenced exceedance rate a detectability proxy rather than a p-value or formal power
Do not interpret equal-weight grid-cell fractions as the prevalence of real candidates
Permit results to stop or broadly redesign the study but not to tune alpha gap rank seeds candidates or formal effect cells
Use a seed namespace disjoint from smoke calibration power real phenotype GPU and v7 work
